producer: Retained Ghidra discovered instructions checked against decoded PE and Capstone operands; no new REA provider execution
limitations: Only discovered instructions with these explicit absolute operands are inventoried.
Constructors initialize fields through object-relative operands; zero direct writes does not mean immutable table state.
Aliased, indirect, computed, generated or external writes are not excluded.
Reading a table slot is different from reading the game address stored in that slot.
No current game build profile or live field semantics are verified by this audit.
